entries.speaker: Female Student's Voice
entries.en: Excuse me.

entries.speaker: Dignified Student
entries.en: Did you wish to see me, Principal[n]Kobayakawa?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: You saw the state Kamoshida-kun was in,[n]didn't you?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: It's as if his personality has completely[n]changed. Something is definitely wrong[n]here.

entries.speaker: Dignified Student
entries.en: I'm not sure I follow...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: From what I've heard, it appears as[n]though some students were meddling[n]in his business.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: If they did something to him... Who could[n]they be?

entries.speaker: Dignified Student
entries.en: Are you saying that these students may[n]have caused Mr. Kamoshida to change?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: That is what I wish to know... Even if it[n]takes some probing into student matters...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I would like you to look into this for me.

entries.speaker: Dignified Student
entries.en: It is true that there are many rumors[n]regarding Mr. Kamoshida, but...

entries.speaker: Dignified Student
entries.en: Do you mean all of this talk about those[n]Phantom Thieves?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: It is undeniable that Mr. Kamoshida has[n]changed in some way. I'd like to have[n]a grasp of the cause.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: This shall also ensure that I handle the[n]mass media and police in the correct[n]fashion.

entries.speaker: Dignified Student
entries.en: Oh...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I will continue speaking to Mr. Kamoshida[n]myself.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Unless you find whomever did this, these[n]irresponsible rumors will likely never die[n]down.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Don't you agree?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: You have been at the top of your class[n]since day one. Your conduct is good,[n]and teachers favor you.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I could write you a recommendation[n]for any college of your choosing,[n]Makoto Niijima.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Th-Thank you...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Your lineage must certainly play a part[n]in this excellence.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Your sister is still young, yet she holds[n]an admirable position at the Public[n]Prosecutor's Office, no?

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: If something disappointing were to[n]happen here, that wouldn't reflect[n]very well on your sister...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: ...Do you understand?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: ...Yes.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Haha, how wise. It's no wonder you're our[n]student council president.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I'd appreciate if you'd look into this as[n]soon as possible. I ask that you begin[n]at once.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yes. If you'll excuse me then.

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: It's me, sir. My apologies for troubling[n]you at such a busy time...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Yes, it's about the matter we discussed[n]earlier...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: I have all bases covered. The investigation[n]will begin immediately...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Mhm, of course... Yes, I will get results...[n]I should be able to update you soon...

entries.speaker: Principal
entries.en: Well then, I must be going. Thank you[n]very much for your time...
